name: Systematic Product Design and Development
description: Introduction to systematic product design and development; product planning (identify opportunities, evaluate and prioritize projects, allocate resources and plan timing); task clarification (identify needs, formulate requirements, house of quality); conceptual design (identify overall function/sub-function, formulate function structures, generate/evaluate/select concepts); embodiment design (steps, checklists, rules, principles and guidelines); detail design.
